label: Act priority at a first being from Metaphysics Theta.8: substance routes, plenitude, rivals
summary: Target: premise warrant for act priority at a first being (61ad11f3) and its composition-route inputs 8288ff1e and 3d99779b, from Metaphysics Theta.8 (1049b4-1051a3) read as analyst reconstructions, attribution deferred (no new claims; locators are navigation). Per priority. (1) In definition (1049b12-17): potency is said by reference to its act; in this vocabulary that is the shared respect index of InPotency x r and InAct y r, so it constrains no being and derives nothing (no formalization). (2) In time (1049b17-1050a3): reaches only potencies being actualized and is vacuous at a first being's idle potency (ATTEMPT-ACT-PRIOR-FROM-MOTION, ATTEMPT-MET-IX-8-ACTUAL-MOVER-PRIORITY; not repeated). (3) In substance, the eternal (1050b6-19, with In Metaph. IX lect. 9): excludes only potency in being (ATTEMPT-ACT-PRIOR-FROM-INCORRUPTIBLE). New: inActOfIncorruptible derives 8288ff1e from 'every first being is simply incorruptible' (ca55ed3a, open analyst) and the sourced reading d017b6b0; firstBeingNoPotencyOfThetaEight composes the existing firstBeingNoPotencyOfComposition (act read as act in being) to derive the q.3 a.1 conclusion 0cf675c4 from ca55ed3a, d017b6b0, the restricted composition premise d8024a38 (act in being plus potency makes composite), ca07cae9, e0088de9 and e078f07b; each of the six is needed (Control.ThetaEightOmissions, models from scripts/countermodel.py, rechecked). d8024a38 is strictly weaker than 3d99779b (strength order, Control.RestrictedStrict) and equivalent to it given STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING (Control.Facts); the two existing composition arguments now record strong_version_needed. Control.HeavenlyFirst: the Theta.8 substance readings, first-being incorruptibility, 8288ff1e and non-overlap leave a first being in potency to a place, so without a composition premise Theta.8 does not reach 61ad11f3. Control.ContingentFirst: 8288ff1e does not imply ca55ed3a, so the Theta.8 support for 8288ff1e is more committal than 8288ff1e itself, an alternative support, not a weaker warrant. (4) In substance, potency for the sake of act (1050a4-b2) read with the tertia via's plenitude premise: firstBeingNoPotencyOfPlenitude derives 0cf675c4 (potency taken at the time now) from b9baf50d (plenitude over an infinite past, existing tertia via reading B), d256e6d2 (the past is infinite, existing), 7371403f (potency in a respect at a time makes act in it possible, open analyst) and 966c08c6 (what was in act in a respect and is later in potency in it has an efficient cause other than itself, open analyst), with e078f07b. It uses no composition premise and no cause of composites, sharing only e078f07b with the composition routes; each premise needed and nonvacuous (Control.PlenitudeOmissions). (5) weakOfNoPotency registers 0cf675c4 -> 61ad11f3 (vacuous; equivalence given non-overlap already in ActPriorityAtFirst.Control.Facts), so every derivation of 0cf675c4 now supports 61ad11f3, including the original act-priority one (a4d3261a, c6d6379b). (6) Joint rival model Control.IdleUncausedComposite: one interpretation satisfies every premise of the composition, Theta.8 and plenitude routes except ca07cae9 and plenitude, with a composite, uncaused first being in potency to a place it never actualizes. So a first being with an unactualized potency is excluded by these routes only through ca07cae9 (or a composition or first-being-act premise) together with a plenitude-route premise, or through e078f07b, which all routes share. Rivals (substantive objection standard; literature named from memory is unread). (a) Contingent first being (Oppy-style contingent initial state, unread): targets ca55ed3a; mechanism: the first being exists but can fail to be; blocks the Theta.8 route only, not the composition route (8288ff1e still holds, ContingentFirst); price: brute contingency of the first being, whose conflict with the corpus's PSR premises is not tested here. (b) Dipolar or process theism (Hartshorne, Whitehead, unread): a first being whose concrete states are composite, unrealized and in part actualized by creatures. Formally it must reject ca07cae9 at a first being (the existing uncaused-composite rival 9ba56a92) and, against the plenitude route, either plenitude (inexhaustible never-actualized potencies) or, where creatures actualize the potency, e078f07b in its respect-unrestricted form (creatures causing an accidental state of God are not simply prior to God); price: priority indexed to respects, which the corpus's PRIOR_1 does not express and no record yet formalizes. Not an established counterexample. (c) Powers ontologies (Molnar; Mumford and Anjum, unread): unmanifested powers of fundamental bearers; mechanism against the plenitude route (manifestation is not required for a power to be real) and against ca07cae9 (uncaused composite fundamentals). Relevance depends on an untested mapping: POTENCY_2 is passive, receptive potency, while many powers are active, which no premise here constrains. (d) Finite past: targets d256e6d2; independent justification: ST I q.46 a.2 (the world's beginning is held by faith, already recorded in the TertiaVia docstring) and the Catholic doctrine of creation with a temporal beginning; if the past is finite the plenitude reading yields nothing, so the plenitude route cannot serve the Catholic root unconditionally. No formal incompatibility with a root statement has been tested. (e) Self-change or spontaneous change against 966c08c6 (self-moving soul; interpretation-dependent quantum transitions): price for a self-changing first being is an internal mover/moved distinction, i.e. composition (Physics VIII.5 analysis, not formalized). (f) d8024a38 and 7371403f: no substantive objection identified under the inclusive SIMPLE_4 reading and the tertia via's sense of Possible; the load lies on ca07cae9 and on plenitude. Overall provisional judgment: of Theta.8's priorities only priority in substance gives anything at a first being. The eternal argument supplies an alternative support for 8288ff1e and, with a weaker composition premise, the q.3 a.1 conclusion, but it is more committal than 8288ff1e and leaves the decisive premise ca07cae9 untouched. The teleology-with-plenitude reconstruction is a genuinely independent route that avoids ca07cae9, but it rests on plenitude over an infinite past, which Aquinas does not assert and the Catholic root's doctrine of a temporal beginning is generally taken to deny; it is therefore a conditional support of limited use for this root. Support for 61ad11f3 remains moderate and rests mainly on the composition route; the live crux is still whether a first being can be an uncaused composite (ca07cae9 at a first being) or have only respect-indexed priority (e078f07b). Revision conditions: raise if ca07cae9 is derived or defended at a first being (e.g. from the corpus's PSR premises) or if e078f07b's respect-unrestricted form gains an independent defense; lower if a read dipolar or powers text supplies a coherent respect-indexed priority compatible with the other root premises; retire the plenitude route for the Catholic root if a corpus statement of a temporal beginning is shown to contradict d256e6d2 on the same Before/now profile, or keep it if a first-being time distinct from world time is shown to make them jointly satisfiable. Nothing is established; every new premise is open.
blocker: Open: every new premise (ca55ed3a, d8024a38, 7371403f, 966c08c6) and the reused ones; the decisive question remains ca07cae9 at a first being and e078f07b's respect-unrestricted form. Next tests: (1) search for a corpus statement of a temporal beginning and test joint satisfiability with d256e6d2 on one Before/now profile; (2) formalize respect-indexed priority (PriorIn c x r) and test whether e078f07b's unrestricted form follows from it plus a bridge, or whether a dipolar model satisfies the respect-indexed version with every other root premise; (3) derive ca07cae9 at a first being from existing PSR premises, or record why not. Literature named here (Oppy, Hartshorne, Whitehead, Molnar, Mumford and Anjum) is unread.
